_comment: Community mailboxes, reconciled against the M365 group export Austin supplied
aliases follow no rule the roster reproduces: obo@ is Ormond Beach, pse@ is
Palm Spring, triples@ is Triple S, vantageoak@ is singular where the roster is
plural, and the group list spells Green Pointe where the roster says Greene.
COUNTERINTUITIVE AND WORTH NOT BREAKING: the unsuffixed whisperingpines@ is
the FLORIDA park and whisperingpinesma@ is Massachusetts. The group names in
the CSV say so explicitly. Swapping them would send one state's numbers to the
Keyed by roster short code. `groups` records which M365 groups share the
address, because two parks on one inbox changes what a message has to say.

_why: Bay Oaks Village 2 has its own M365 group but shares Village 1's address, so
the roster's second entry routes to the same inbox.
Northgate RV has no group of its own; the single `northgate` group covers
both the MH and RV sides.
Anything sent to a shared inbox MUST name the community in the subject, or
the recipient cannot tell which park it concerns.

_groups_without_a_live_community.geigerkey: Geiger Key RV Resort, removed from the roster at Austin's direction. Group exists; nothing routes to it.
_groups_without_a_live_community.shellpointe: Shell Pointe MHC, sold July 2026. Group still exists; nothing may route to it.

_why: Austin 2026-09-09: Silver Breeze is being renamed to Space Coast Village, and
Spacecoastvillage@ already exists. That is why the group reconciliation showed
an orphan mailbox with no community -- it is the successor, not a leftover.
ROUTING STAYS ON silverbreeze@ until the rename lands in the Property Data
Sheet. Sending to the new address before the team watches it loses the mail;
sending to both duplicates every alert. When the PDS renames the community,
flip `communities.SILVER` to the future alias and delete this block.
The roster will also need its alias map updated so the warehouse and Rent
Manager spellings of the old name still resolve -- both systems will keep
saying Silver Breeze long after the PDS changes.

_not_a_community.regionalmgmt: A real mailbox but deliberately NOT a routing option, per Austin 2026-09-09. Every community now has its own address, so there is no fallback case left to need it.
